import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.PID
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Localization
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Integer
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.GaussLemma
#check_failure Roth.Θ_nonneg
#check @Real.sSup_nonneg
#check @Real.sSup_nonneg'
#check @Real.sInf_nonneg
namespace ThetaNonneg188Isolated
universe u v
theorem law {s : Set ℝ} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ sSup s :=
  Real.sSup_nonneg hs
theorem family {A : Type u} {H : Type v} (f : A → H → ℝ) (s : Set A) (t : Set H)
    (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ h ∈ t, 0 ≤ f a h) : 0 ≤ sSup (Set.image2 f s t) :=
  Real.sSup_nonneg (Set.forall_mem_image2.mpr hf)
theorem witness {s : Set ℝ} (hs : ∃ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ sSup s :=
  Real.sSup_nonneg' hs
theorem empty : sSup (∅ : Set ℝ) = 0 := Real.sSup_empty
theorem unbounded {s : Set ℝ} (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) : sSup s = 0 :=
  Real.sSup_of_not_bddAbove hs
theorem signed_guard : ¬ (∀ s : Set ℝ, 0 ≤ sSup s) := by
  intro h
  have := h ({-1} : Set ℝ)
  simp only [csSup_singleton] at this
  norm_num at this
#print axioms signed_guard
#print axioms law
#print axioms family
#print axioms witness
#print axioms empty
#print axioms unbounded
end ThetaNonneg188Isolated
